title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text: 75. Stresses the importance of the Southern Neighbourhood line in supporting political, economic and social reforms in the region taking into consideration the increasing humanitarian needs in the region as well as other purposes of regional cooperation in providing assistance to refugees, in particular Syrian and Palestinian refugees; demands that Union funding in the Gaza area should have humanitarian relief as primary objective; underlines that beneficiaries of Union support cannot be compromised by terrorist organisations and extremist groups, and funding should not go to EU-listed terrorist organisations such as Hamas in Gaza; in that context, highlights the need to re-think the role of UNRWA and work on the gradual transition of humanitarian and development activities to non-compromised, impartial organisations and local authorities;
